summary: Mayor John Tory has advised Toronto City Council that in accordance with Chapter 27, Council Procedures, of the Toronto Municipal Code, he consents to the election of a Speaker and Deputy Speaker by City Council. City Council will elect the Speaker and Deputy Speaker by public ballot.
decided: City Council on December 4, 5 and 13, 2018: 1. Elected Councillor Frances Nunziata as Speaker for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022. 2. Elected Councillor Shelley Carroll as Deputy Speaker for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022.

motions.desc: Majority required - Appoint Councillor Nunziata as Speaker
Majority required - Appoint Councillor Carroll as Deputy Speaker

text: Mayor John Tory has advised Toronto City Council that in accordance with Chapter 27, Council Procedures, of the Toronto Municipal Code, he consents to the election of a Speaker and Deputy Speaker by City Council. City Council will elect the Speaker and Deputy Speaker by public ballot.

City Council on December 4, 5 and 13, 2018: 1. Elected Councillor Frances Nunziata as Speaker for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022. 2. Elected Councillor Shelley Carroll as Deputy Speaker for a term of office ending on November 14, 2022.
